summary: Gold headed for a third straight weekly gain, trading near $4,540, as the dollar slid and investors reacted to the Treasury's decision to expand long-dated bond buybacks. Crypto surged after the Treasury intervened in bond markets and President Trump urged Congress to pass the CLARITY Act, with a White House meeting of crypto executives and regulators triggering a record $2.7 billion short squeeze.
tweet: Treasury bond buybacks crushed the dollar and lit up gold, while Trump's CLARITY Act push and a record $2.7B crypto short squeeze sent Bitcoin past $75K for the first time since May.
